$comment: Universal links and Android app links (decisions.md 58). Fill these, from the Apple developer account (Membership: Team ID) and the Play Console (Setup, App signing: SHA-256 certificate fingerprint, and the upload key's for internal testing builds), then deploy the web app: npm run export:web writes /.well-known/apple-app-site-association and /.well-known/assetlinks.json from them. Empty, the files are left out and links open the web app.
